body_text:
Mean value theorem. Let $a<b$. If $f:[a,b]\to\mathbb{R}$ is
continuous on the closed interval and differentiable on the open
interval $(a,b)$, then there exists $c\in(a,b)$ such that
$f'(c)=(f(b)-f(a))/(b-a)$. Continuity at the endpoints and
differentiability in the interior are separate hypotheses.
